sections.heading: Hungarian Alphabet
paragraphs: Hungarian has 44 letters including special characters.
Stress is always on the first syllable.

sections.heading: Vowel Harmony Overview
paragraphs: Hungarian words follow vowel harmony, meaning suffixes change depending on the vowels in the word.
There are three groups of vowels: front (e, é, i, í, ö, ő, ü, ű), back (a, á, o, ó, u, ú), and mixed words (that contain both).

sections.heading: Suffix Harmony Rules
paragraphs: Back vowel words usually take back vowel suffixes (ban, -nak).
Front vowel words usually take front vowel suffixes (ben, -nek).
Mixed words usually follow the last vowel.

sections.heading: Examples
list: telefonban – in the phone (mixed word, last vowel 'o' → -ban)
